title: Full-span generated rhythms
playback_note: Untouched seed-608 generated baseline versus complete new rhythmic spans. Same mapped pitches/voices, tempo, GM guitar and gain; contacts are re-solved and model accents may change. Color correspondence chooses exact source occurrence first, otherwise nearest; extra repeats are new identities. Human listening pending. 150 BPM. Corrected source fit uses conservative metadata alias groups, not independently verified compositions. Token timing probabilities are source-fitted; full-form planning and melody-mapping policies are authored. Space and connected labels describe intentions, not measured superiority. Human listening acceptance is pending. Earlier first-fit audio remains preserved.
questions: Do the new rhythms still sound like the original melodic idea?
Which version has the clearest build and release across all eight bars?
Where do the new accents, gaps or repeated attacks feel awkward?
